name: sitesnap
description: Local configurable screenshot studio for responsive pages and interactive states

scripts.setup: npm install && npx playwright install chromium
scripts.check: npm ls --depth=0 && npm run build && node --check index.js && node --check core/actions.js && node --check core/browser.js && node --check core/capture.js && node --check core/runner.js && node --check core/utils.js && node --test && node scripts/smoke-app.js && node scripts/check-vercel.js && node scripts/check-vercel-open.js
scripts.check:vercel: npm run build && node scripts/check-vercel.js && node scripts/check-vercel-open.js
